tracesTo: UserFlow: League Access, Switching & Role-Based Experience

stories.title: Display League Switcher for Multi-League Users
stories.goal: see all my leagues in a switcher interface
stories.benefit: I can easily navigate between different league clubhouses I belong to
acceptanceCriteria: System displays league switcher in header/navigation when user belongs to multiple leagues
League switcher shows list of all leagues user has membership in
Each league entry displays league name and optional logo/icon
Current active league is visually highlighted in the switcher
League switcher is accessible from any page within the application
System sorts leagues alphabetically or by most recently accessed

stories.title: Switch Between Leagues
stories.goal: switch from one league clubhouse to another
stories.benefit: I can access different league spaces and their specific content without re-authenticating
acceptanceCriteria: User can click on a league in the switcher to change active league
System updates league context globally across the application
System redirects to appropriate landing page for selected league (typically newsfeed)
All subsequent navigation and data fetching uses new league context
System persists last selected league in user session for next visit
League switch action is immediate without page refresh lag

stories.title: Direct Route Single-League Users to Their League
stories.goal: be automatically directed to my league clubhouse without selecting from a switcher
stories.benefit: I have a streamlined experience without unnecessary navigation steps
acceptanceCriteria: System detects user belongs to only one league upon login
System automatically sets that league as active league context
User is redirected directly to league clubhouse landing page (newsfeed)
System does not display league switcher interface for single-league users
If user later joins additional leagues, system automatically enables league switcher
System handles edge case where user has no league memberships with appropriate messaging

stories.title: Maintain League Context Across Navigation
stories.goal: stay within the context of my selected league as I navigate between pages
stories.benefit: all content and features I access are relevant to the current league without confusion
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains league context in URL structure (e.g., /leagues/[leagueId]/feed)
All page navigation preserves current league context in routing
API calls and data queries automatically use current league context
System prevents cross-league data leakage by validating league context on all requests
Browser back/forward buttons correctly maintain league context
System stores league context in application state management (React Context or similar)

stories.title: Display League Identity in Navigation
stories.goal: clearly see which league I am currently viewing
stories.benefit: I always know which league space I am in to avoid confusion
acceptanceCriteria: System displays current league name prominently in header or navigation
League identity includes league logo or icon if available
Current league indicator remains visible on all pages within league context
System uses visual design to distinguish league identity from other UI elements
League name is clickable to access league switcher (for multi-league users)
System displays league URL slug as additional context indicator if appropriate

stories.title: Handle League Access Permissions During Navigation
stories.goal: only access leagues I have valid membership in
stories.benefit: I am protected from accessing unauthorized league spaces and see appropriate error messages
acceptanceCriteria: System validates user has active membership before allowing league context switch
System checks membership status and approval state for league access
Unapproved or revoked memberships prevent league access with clear messaging
System redirects unauthorized users to appropriate page (e.g., membership pending page)
System handles deep links to league pages by validating access before rendering
Error messages explain why access is denied and provide next steps (e.g., 'Membership pending approval')

stories.title: Switch League While Preserving Page Type
stories.goal: stay on the same type of page (e.g., matchups) when I switch to a different league
stories.benefit: I can compare the same information across multiple leagues efficiently
acceptanceCriteria: System detects current page type when user initiates league switch
System attempts to route to equivalent page in new league context (e.g., matchups → matchups)
If equivalent page exists in new league, user is directed there after switch
If equivalent page does not exist or is not accessible, user is directed to league landing page with optional notification
System preserves URL structure pattern across league switches where possible
User can disable this behavior via preference to always land on newsfeed after switch

stories.title: Display League Membership Count in Switcher
stories.goal: see how many leagues I belong to at a glance
stories.benefit: I understand the scope of my league memberships without counting manually
acceptanceCriteria: System displays total count of user's league memberships in league switcher UI
Count updates dynamically when user joins or leaves leagues
System distinguishes between active, pending, and archived league memberships in count if applicable
Count is visible before opening full league switcher menu
System handles large numbers of leagues gracefully (e.g., 10+ leagues) with scrollable list
Count includes only leagues where user has approved membership status

stories.title: Search and Filter Leagues in Switcher
stories.goal: quickly find a specific league when I belong to many leagues
stories.benefit: I can efficiently locate and switch to the league I want without scrolling through long lists
acceptanceCriteria: System provides search input in league switcher when user has 5+ leagues
Search filters leagues by name in real-time as user types
Search is case-insensitive and matches partial strings
System highlights matching text in league names during search
Search results update instantly without server round-trip for better UX
System clears search when switcher is closed or league is selected

stories.title: Handle League Switcher on Mobile Devices
stories.goal: access and use league switcher on my mobile device
stories.benefit: I have a touch-optimized experience for switching between leagues on small screens
acceptanceCriteria: System adapts league switcher UI for mobile viewport sizes
League switcher trigger is easily tappable with appropriate touch target size
League switcher menu displays in mobile-friendly format (e.g., bottom sheet or full-screen modal)
League list items have adequate spacing for touch interaction without mis-taps
System provides smooth animations for opening/closing league switcher on mobile
Mobile league switcher respects device safe areas and navigation gestures
